title: News impact event v1 — fact-integrity templates
description: Fact-integrity templates for the news-impact Phase 0 freeze: capital_allocation_event.v1, demand_guidance_contract_event.v1 and strategic_product_partnership_event.v1. Output is context_only data that never authorizes a trade, size, entry or rank; every template is closed and every numeric critical field binds to owner evidence — a source_span.v1 payload or a typed field_absence.v1.
